text:
anna-frontend: Quick deploy check — who's on console UI deploy tonight? I'm planning for 21:00 UTC. major items: feature-toggle rollout for new search, service-worker update, and asset hash bump. need CDN invalidation + smoke. Can someone confirm they can run the purge and be ready to rollback?

liam-release: I'm on for 21:00 UTC. will handle canary slotting. planning 10% for 15m then 100% if green. :thumbsup:

javier-eng: I can run the CloudFront invalidation. which paths? do we need to invalidate `/assets/*` and `/sw.js`? also do we want to set short TTL on `index.html` prior to release?

anna-frontend: Yes invalidate `/assets/*` and `/sw.js`. We'll set `index.html` TTL to 60s for the rollout window. I'll push the feature flag at 21:05 after canary looks good.

maya-design: fyi the cookie banner change is behind the feature flag — if we rollback we should revert flag first. I'll be available for quick visual smoke.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved: 2026-03-17 21:00 UTC — slot ID deploy-2119 — watchers: liam-release, javier-eng, anna-frontend

javier-eng: CloudFront invalidation command:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12ABC34D5EFG --paths "/assets/*" "/sw.js"
```
I'll run it immediately after canary goes green.

liam-release: Smoke checklist (quick):
- sanity /health -> 200
- frontpage load within 500ms (edge)
- search returns results for `redwood`
- service worker registers
I'll run these from eu-west-1 and us-east-1.

anna-frontend: Rollback drill (quick):
1) flip feature flag to off
2) revert nginx/edge route if needed
3) deploy previous bundle (artifact tag `console-2026.03.16-rc4`)
4) confirm /health and a couple of critical flows
If anyone can't do step 3, ping @liam-release.

sre-bot: Reminder: metrics to watch — requests/second, 99th latency, error rate, CPU on web nodes. Alert threshold set for 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.

javier-eng: noted. Who will run artifact rollback? I can trigger invalidation for rollback after artifact revert if needed.

anna-frontend: I'll coordinate the flag flip and visual smoke. liam please be ready to trigger full deploy rollback. maya will do quick UI verification. thanks all — see you at 21:00 UTC. :rocket:
